links.outcome: Clinical harm and attack success rates under direct and RAG-mediated prompt injection
links.effect: ASR2 and CHER3 can diverge substantially; observed rates vary depending on whether adversarial instructions appear in the user query or in retrieved context. Numeric rates not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluating MPIB across a diverse set of baseline LLMs and defense configurations, we find that ASR$_2$ and CHER$_3$ can diverge substantially, and that observed rates vary depending on whether adversarial instructions appear in the user query or in retrieved context.

unlisted_practices: Outcome-level clinical harm metric (Clinical Harm Event Rate) for evaluating prompt injection safety
Evaluating prompt injection defense configurations on a clinical benchmark

screen.reason: The study develops a benchmark for medical prompt injection attacks and clinical safety, evaluating various baseline LLMs and defense configurations to mitigate safety risks.
